results.title: Hawthorn Bancshares Announces Cash Dividend
results.description: JEFFERSON CITY, Mo., Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Hawthorn Bancshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: HWBK) announced today that on October 28, 2026 its Board of Directors approved a quarterly cash dividend of $0.21 per common share. The dividend is payable on January 1, 2027 to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 15, 2026.

results.title: 'I want to build fielding as an attacking weapon': New Mumbai Indians fielding coach T Dilip
results.description: Newly appointed Mumbai Indians fielding coach T Dilip wants to make fielding one of the team's biggest strengths. He believes that a strong fielding unit can change the course of a match and wants to build a culture based on trust, respect and enjoyment. Dilip, who has previously worked as India's fielding coach, was one of three new members of the Mumbai Indians support staff announced on Friday.
